name: Threadwaste Patchwork Shorts — Knee Length
description: Knee-length shorts assembled from mismatched fabric scraps — denim, canvas, synth-linen — in a deliberately chaotic patchwork. Each pair is unique. Waistband is a repurposed leather-analog belt strip with D-ring adjustment. Very Shelf, increasingly worn by Tier 3 kids as ironic casual.
functionality: D-ring waistband adjusts for a range of fits; reinforced seat seam for durability.
what_it_says: Either you can't afford better or you're making a point — the cut of your chrome tells people which.
story_hooks: A specific fabric swatch in this pair was cut from a Corponation uniform — someone left that in deliberately.
Tier 3 resellers are buying these at Shelf prices and flipping them at triple the cost in the Circuit night market.
